technical_summary: SMB web app, React front-end using EventSource for streaming; expects function calls with strict JSON objects. Issue appears when model output is streamed and schema boundaries cross chunk boundaries. Probable mitigations: server-side delimiting, use of structured output mode (JSON mode) with explicit object per event, or client-side tolerant parser with incremental assembly.
